text: Astute means quick to notice things and use them to make smart choices. Here, Ella Langley used social media in a clever, well-planned way.
Hallowed means treated as very special and deserving of great respect, often because of a long history. Famous singers have played at the Grand Ole Opry for decades.
Grating means irritating, like a sound that scrapes on your nerves. A song with grating hooks would get annoying after a few plays, but this one does not.
A stint is a period of time spent doing something. Here, it is how long a song stayed at number one.
Schmaltzy describes something that is sweet and sentimental in a way that can feel a little over the top.
An anthem is a song that is famous and loved by lots of people. Here it means a very popular holiday song.
Festive means joyful and connected to a celebration, like a holiday.
Twangy describes a sound with a bright, ringing buzz, like country guitars or a country singer's accent.
A honky-tonk is a noisy, casual bar where country music is played live.
A trope is an idea or theme that gets used again and again in stories and songs, like heartbreak in country music.
A genre is a type of music, movie or book, like country, rock or mystery.
An ascent is a climb upward. Here, it means her rise to fame.
Rhythm is the beat of a piece of music. Saying a business finds a new rhythm means it is finding a new way of working.
To stream music is to play it over the internet instead of buying a copy. A streamer is a service, like Spotify, that does this.
Royalties are payments that artists get each time their music is played or sold.
Here, labels are record labels, the companies that help make and sell music.
To don something is to put it on, usually clothing. Pop stars donning cowboy boots means they started dressing country.
Rumours are stories people pass around that may or may not be true.
Boot-scootin' music is lively country music that makes people want to dance.
A breakout success is the moment when someone suddenly becomes well known.
Pastoral means connected to peaceful country life, with farms, animals and open fields.
Charm is a pleasing quality that makes people like something.
Hymns are religious songs that people sing in church.
The Grand Ole Opry is a famous country music show in Nashville, Tennessee. Playing there is a big honor.
Loretta Lynn was a very famous country singer who died in 2022.
Dolly Parton is a world-famous country singer and songwriter.
When a video goes viral, it spreads very fast as many people watch it and share it online.
A snippet is a small piece of something, like a short bit of a song.
Collaborations are times when two or more artists work together on a project.
Aesthetics are the look and feel of something, like its style and mood.
Americana is things that feel traditionally American, like cowboy boots, folk music and small-town life.
A digitally native person grew up with the internet, so online life feels natural to them.
Mellow means smooth, calm and relaxing.
Here, strains means the sounds of a piece of music.
A hook is the catchy part of a song that gets stuck in your head.
A riff is a short, repeated pattern of notes, usually on a guitar.
A husky voice is deep and a little rough, but pleasant.
Sheryl Crow is an American rock and country singer who was very popular in the 1990s.
A crossover is a song that becomes popular with fans of a different kind of music.
TikTok is a social-media app where people share short videos, often with music.
Spotify is a popular app for streaming music.
The Billboard Hot 100 is a weekly list of the 100 most popular songs in America.
Mariah Carey is a famous pop singer known for her Christmas song.
Taylor Swift is a very famous singer who began in country music before moving to pop.
